projects.title: AVIbe Society
projects.description:
Tech Stack - TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Axios, Express, React-Router, React, Cloudinary, Material-UI, Passport/Google O-Auth, AWS EC2, AWS RDS, ES-Lint, Webpack, NGinx

An application made for all types of music lovers. From the casual listener to the hardcore festival/concertgoer, this app lets you discover new songs and keep up-to-date with where your favorite artists will be, and plan your next adventures with ease.

• Utilized React Router’s useNavigate API to seamlessly transition the user throughout the different features of the application
• Making Axios requests to the Ticketmaster and TripAdvisor APIs as well as GET requests to the PostgreSQL database to dynamically render event data and Hotel information for the user.
• Created reusable, web accessibility compliant React components using Material UI

projects.title: Beastie Booze
projects.description:
Tech Stack - Express, AWS, MongoDB Atlas, Material UI, ESlint AirBnB, BootStrap, React

A web application that allows users to discover staple cocktail recipes and custom drink recipes submitted by other users. The application also includes features such as a shopping cart which displays a list of ingredients for recipes a user saved and an event creation component ponent 

• Worked in a pre-existing code base deciphering what was taking place and implemented brand new features to make the application more versatile for users.
• Interacted with an already created NoSQL database and implemented a new collection to store information about Events a user would create
